Subject: FastService trial onboarding — invoice-only request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — were excited to run the 30-day pilot with Redwood. Procurement on our side is simple, but our finance team prefers to route small pilots via invoicing rather than a formal PO workflow (we use invoice-only for short trials to speed up time-to-production).

Pilot details:
- Scope: API access for two engineers, 5M tokens/month cap
- Estimated first invoice: $4,900 (one-time trial fee)
- Start date target: July 1

Can FastService be onboarded on an invoice-only path for the initial 90 days? If Redwood requires evidence or an addendum, we can provide W-9, SoW, and insurance certificate right away (attached).

Next steps from our side: please confirm what evidence you need and whether a temporary exemption is possible.

Thanks,
Elena Mendez
Director, Partnerships
FastService Inc.

(415) 555-0198

Elena,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments — I skimmed them and they look fine, but Procurement will need to confirm a few things before we can accept an invoice-only onboarding lane. To speed this up, heres what I propose and what well need from FastService: 

Proposed temporary exemption (internal pre-approval request):
- Duration: 90 days trial window
- Spend cap: $15,000 cumulative during window (covers expected ramp + buffer)
- Billing cadence: Net 30 invoices submitted monthly to finance@redwood.com
- Evidence required: completed W-9, signed SoW, COI
- Contracting: sign a short addendum acknowledging invoice-only path and that PO requirement will resume after the window

Action items for FastService: please upload the three docs to the vendor intake link (https://redwood.app/vendor-intake/upload?hs=98765) and confirm the billing contact and remit address. If Procurement (ccd) signs off I can request a temporary allowlist so Billing can accept invoices without a PO.

Marissa / Naomi — can you review the proposed cap/duration and advise any additional evidence or restrictions (e.g., minimum invoice labeling, tax form verification) that we should require? If this looks OK Ill submit the request through the allowance playbook.

Jonas

Elena / team,

Thanks for the uploads and for confirming the billing contact. Procurement has reviewed the materials and we can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding lane with the following conditions: 

1) Approved temporary exemption: 90 days from activation date (activation = first invoice receipt).
2) Cumulative spend cap: $15,000 during the exemption window. If invoices approach 80% of the cap, Procurement will notify both parties to discuss a PO or alternate path.
3) Required addendum: FastService and Redwood must sign a short exemption addendum (attached) that (a) records the cap/duration, (b) confirms billing contact and remit address, and (c) acknowledges PO requirement will resume after the window unless a permanent exception is approved.
4) Invoicing rules: each invoice must include the trial order reference "SF-TRIAL-3421" and be sent to finance@redwood.com with cc to procurement@redwood.com. Net 30 terms.
5) Evidence retention: Procurement reserves the right to request additional compliance documents (e.g., SOC2 in future) during the trial.

Once the addendum is returned signed well add FastService to the temporary allowlist and notify Billing. Expect onboarding to complete within 2 business days after addendum execution.

Elena — I attached the exemption addendum (temporary-exemption-addendum.docx). Please countersign and return to procurement@redwood.com. Ill loop in Billing for the allowlist activation.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
